listing.name: Imabikisō — Imabikisou PC Recompilation (yasindevs)
listing.summary: Upstream reports the opening, first classroom narration, early saving and input. Most of the game remains untested. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese BLJM60042 version 01.00 disc and files generated locally from it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the developer source-build instructions and launcher setup with your own disc. Machine-translated English preview content is optional.

warnings: Upstream reports the opening, first classroom narration, early saving and input. Most of the game remains untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
